title: Parts bin with hinged lid
summary: A small two-compartment bin. The lid swings open on a steel pin and snaps shut on two pairs of magnets.

hardware.notes: Press fit in 6.2 mm pockets, 3.2 mm deep.
Any 3 mm steel rod cut to 60 mm works.

consumables.name: Superglue (CA)
consumables.qty: a drop per magnet, only if loose

motions.label: Lid opens
motions.check: Swings open to about 110° without rubbing and snaps shut on the magnets.

steps.title: Press in the base magnets
steps.text: Press one magnet into each front corner post.
steps.check: Both magnets sit flush with the top of the posts.
tips: If a magnet is loose, add a drop of superglue first.

steps.title: Slide in the divider
steps.text: Slide the divider down between the ribs, notch up.
steps.check: The divider stands straight and does not wobble.

steps.title: Press in the lid magnets
steps.text: Press the other two magnets into the pockets under the lid.
warnings: Test before pressing: each lid magnet must pull towards the base magnet below it. If it pushes away, flip it over.
steps.check: Held over the base, the lid pulls down onto it.

steps.title: Fit the hinge pin
steps.text: Line up the three hinge loops and push the pin through from the side.
steps.check: The lid swings open and shut smoothly and the pin stays put.

steps.title: Stick on the feet
steps.text: Turn the bin over and stick a bumper near each corner.
steps.check: The bin sits flat without rocking.
